players.product: LTCC multilayer ceramic space transformers (STF) for DRAM / HBM wafer probe cards

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 revenue KRW 58,440,046,279 and operating profit KRW 17,208,490,550; the company states revenue rose 69.5% and operating profit 252.3% year on year. Q2 2026 revenue KRW 31,265,241,801 and operating profit KRW 9,529,353,435
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue KRW 58,440,046,279 (+69.5% YoY); operating profit KRW 17,208,490,550 (+252.3% YoY)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue by product: ceramic STF for NAND probe cards KRW 37,834M (64.7%), for DRAM probe cards KRW 18,713M (32.0%), for non-memory probe cards KRW 102M (0.2%), other KRW 1,791M (3.1%); domestic KRW 34,876M and overseas KRW 23,564M. Its customers are domestic and overseas probe-card makers and the end users are chipmakers; on a chipmaker basis supply is 60% domestic and 40% overseas
quarterly_data.figure: NAND STF KRW 37,834M (64.7%); DRAM STF KRW 18,713M (32.0%); end users 60% domestic / 40% overseas

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 ceramic STF capacity 3,120 sheets, production 2,551 sheets, average utilisation 82% (FY2025: capacity 6,240, production 3,668); the company is adding new production facilities at its new Osong plant to expand capacity

DRAM / HBM share of revenue rose from about 10% in 2023 to the mid-30% range by H1 2026; the company is supplying samples and mass-production volumes of ultra-precision, large-area substrates in line with major domestic and overseas IDMs' HBM roadmaps, and is running research and mass-production evaluations of next-generation HBM-dedicated ceramic substrates with global IDMs and probe-card makers as HBM3E and HBM4 ramp in 2026
quarterly_data.figure: DRAM / HBM about 10% of revenue in 2023, mid-30% range in H1 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Non-memory: the company completed evaluation of a product for a US AI processor in 2026 and plans full mass-production supply in 2026; the customer adopted its LTCC ceramic substrate for testing AI package chips

Customer concentration (customers not named in the note): three customers each above 10% of H1 2026 revenue - Customer A KRW 17,613,622 thousand (ratio 0.3014), Customer B KRW 15,106,165 thousand (0.2585), Customer C KRW 14,253,631 thousand (0.2439); H1 2025: KRW 12,327,297 thousand, KRW 6,529,302 thousand and KRW 10,483,627 thousand
quarterly_data.figure: Customer A KRW 17,613,622 thousand; Customer B KRW 15,106,165 thousand; Customer C KRW 14,253,631 thousand
quarterly_data.counterparty: undisclosed Customers A, B and C

players.product: LTCC multilayer ceramic space transformers (STF) for NAND wafer probe cards

quarterly_data.signal: NAND: the company says it leads supply of high-spec substrates as next-generation NAND enters mass production and expects the share of special-purpose NAND substrates such as high-bandwidth flash (HBF) to grow further in 2026; it has diversified overseas sales through new Greater China and European customers secured since 2023. Domestic NAND probe-card makers use its LTCC substrates, and it supplies overseas chipmakers through a Japanese probe-card maker

SEMCNS.why: Makes LTCC ceramic space transformers, the core substrate of memory wafer probe cards (NAND 64.7%, DRAM 32.0% of H1 2026 revenue); demand rises with NAND and HBM wafer-test volumes
SEMCNS.evidence: SEMCNS Q2 FY2026 (08-14-2026): manufactures and supplies ceramic STF (space transformers) for semiconductor probe cards used in the test process; DRAM / HBM share rising to the mid-30% range with HBM substrate samples and mass-production supply to major IDMs
